# Industry 3.0 Manufacturing Management Application

## Project Overview
A comprehensive manufacturing management system built with:
- **Backend**: Spring Boot (Java) - SaaS architecture
- **Frontend**: React.js - Responsive web interface  
- **Database**: MySQL - Production and inventory data
- **Features**: Production management, inventory tracking, quality control, analytics

## Technology Stack
- Java 17+ with Spring Boot 3.x
- React 18+ with modern hooks
- MySQL 8.x database
- Maven for backend dependency management
- npm/yarn for frontend dependencies

## Project Structure
```
/
├── backend/          # Spring Boot application
├── frontend/         # React application  
├── database/         # MySQL scripts and schemas
└── docs/            # Documentation
```

## Development Guidelines
- Follow REST API conventions
- Use responsive design principles
- Implement proper error handling
- Include unit and integration tests
- Use environment-based configuration
